title: Game-RL Protocol Core Definitions
description: Shared JSON Schema definitions for the Game-RL Protocol 2.0.0-draft02. Payload field names are PascalCase per spec section 1.5 (REQ-NAME-02).

AgentType.description: Agent role: Observer (watch only), Player (player avatar), Entity (single NPC/unit), Controller (strategic control of many entities), System (environmental systems), Director (narrative/combat direction)

Scope.description: Agency scope: embodied (diegetic, has an Avatar with physics body and sensor-local observation) or systemic (non-diegetic, global observation and administrative actions)

ClockMode.description: Clock ownership: training (agent-owned, lockstep, deterministic) or live (engine-owned, real-time)

SessionType.description: Session topology: exclusive (one connection owns the game process) or shared (game accepts multiple IPC connections and outlives agents)

Position.description: 2D integer cell coordinate in the game's map grid

StateHash.description: SHA-256 state hash prefixed with algorithm identifier; stable for identical states (REQ-DET-02)

Severity.description: Severity rank: 0 = info, 1 = low, 2 = warning, 3 = critical

Anchor.description: Spatial anchor (spec section 7.2, REQ-SPA-01): an entity ID, zone label, type name, or landmark ID string; an offset object displacing a resolved anchor; or literal coordinates as an escape hatch

oneOf.description: Entity ID (e.g. 'Stockpile_4821'), zone label ('Kitchen stockpile'), type name ('CookStove', resolved to the nearest instance to the agent's Reference Point), or landmark ID ('Region_NE', 'FertileCluster_0', 'ColonyCenter', 'MapCenter')
Offset anchor: the resolved Anchor displaced Distance cells toward Direction (8-wind compass)

Anchor.description: Base anchor to displace from (any string anchor form)

oneOf.description: Coordinate escape hatch: a literal map position

Event.description: Notable simulation event surfaced in step results (spec section 5.2)

Tick.description: Simulation tick when the event occurred
